Primary request: 赫因·阿兹拉, title 寂王, commander of the imperial expedition and the principal ideological opponent.
Subject: an imposing mature MALE adult anime commander, tall measured posture, clearly distinct from the lean young Earth swordsman. Severe clean-lined face, composed narrowed anime eyes, meticulously controlled expression, hair neatly swept back. His menace comes from disciplined certainty, never shouting or a grotesque villain grin.
Clothing/equipment: immaculate, structurally simple interstellar armor over a strict high-collared military underlayer. Broad uninterrupted armor planes and ordered lines; only a small restrained geometric rank insignia concentrated on the chest/shoulder. No royal crown, jewels, horns or huge cape. The overall silhouette embodies imposed quiet order.
Weapon: ONE personal adaptation of a regulation heavy straight sword: THICK blade, visibly broad energy-conduction spine, layered protective energy hardware. It must contrast with 凌烬's very narrow blade. Unnamed weapon; do not add a sword name. He holds it with controlled ease in a low vertical rest position beside him, full blade visible. A few faint closely layered technological field bands hint at redundant defense without hiding his armor.
Backdrop: a quiet imperial starship command antechamber, ordered machined surfaces and a distant viewport containing the curve of Earth; sparse and subdued.
Appearance constraint: his species and biological age have not been established. Use a provisional human-like ANIME visual design with ordinary ears, natural understated skin and no invented alien biological traits. This is a visual proposal, not a canonical species declaration.
Visual emphasis: immaculate discipline, thick sword, layered technical defense, calm authority and unsettling certainty.
